cohort: 150 pregnant women with singleton, uncomplicated pregnancies in their first 12 weeks of gestation at Rangaraya Medical College, Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh, India
finding: There was a significant correlation between early pregnancy BMI and maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Obese and overweight women were more likely to have instrumental or caesarean births, while underweight women also had an increased incidence of caesarean sections.
followup_time: Until delivery and postpartum period (exact time not specified)
